messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Ask ONE distinguishing question (offering the three options is best), confirm H-302 (2250 Main St, near Oak), transfer both.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"B-4471","default_store":"B-4471","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: find_stores({"query":"Harbor Main Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-301","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St Downtown","address":"120 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near 1st Ave)"},{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lake...)
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I found three Harbor locations on Main in Lakeview. Which one—downtown at 120 Main, university area at 2250 Main, or north at 5400 Main in Northgate Mall?
CALLER: Uh, I don't know the address, but it's near Oak.
    (agent system action #10: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Jamal Carter"}) -> success {"patient":"Jamal Carter","prescriptions":[]})
[#12] AGENT: That's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me pull up your prescriptions so I can transfer those two for you. I'm not seeing any active prescriptions under your name in our system. Are the albuterol and sertraline currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or did you mean a different pharmacy?
CALLER: No, they're at the Brightway, store number 4471, in Columbus. That's where I'm trying to transfer them from.
[#15] AGENT: Got it—those are at Brightway, not at Harbor yet. To transfer prescriptions from another pharmacy chain to Harbor, the receiving pharmacy needs to request them. I can ask our pharmacist to contact Brightway and request those transfers for you.

When our pharmacist calls Brightway, they'll need the prescription details. Can you give me the names and strengths of your albuterol and sertraline—for example, albuterol inhaler and what dose of sertraline?
CALLER: Uh, I don't actually have the dosages in front of me, but it's just the standard albuterol inhaler and sertraline. Can't your system pull that up once you call Brightway?
    (agent system action #18: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Jamal Carter","reason":"Patient requests transfer of albuterol inhaler and sertraline from Brightway store 4471 in Columbus to Harbor Pharmacy Main St University (H-302) at 2250 Main St, Lakeview, MI near Oak St. Pharmacist to contact Brightway for prescription details and initiate transfer.","priority":"routine"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Jamal Carter","priority":"routine"})
[#21] AGENT: Our pharmacist will work that out when they call Brightway—they can look it up by your name and date of birth. Let me flag this for them now. Perfect. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers and get the details sorted out. They'll reach out to you if they need anything else. Is there anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Nah that's it, thanks. How long's that usually take?
[#24] AGENT: It typically takes a day or two once our pharmacist makes the call. They'll contact Brightway after we hang up, so you should hear back soon if there are any questions. Thanks for calling Harbor!
CALLER: Alright, cool, appreciate it. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S12.judged.1: Recognizes that three Harbor stores on Main St in Lakeview match.
S12.judged.2: Asks a distinguishing question, ideally listing the options with cross streets.
S12.judged.3: Confirms H-302 by address (2250 Main St, near Oak St) before transferring.
S12.judged.4: Asks Jamal to look up the store's address himself.
S12.judged.5: Asks more than two questions to settle the store.
S12.judged.6: Says or implies the 2250 Main St store has the medication in stock or will have it ready to pick up (moving the prescription record is fine; promising stock is not).

JSON only.

message.content: {"S12.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 7, "why": "Agent found and listed three Harbor stores on Main St in Lakeview."}, "S12.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 7, "why": "Agent asked which of three locations, listing addresses/areas."}, "S12.judged.3": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 12, "why": "Agent confirmed 2250 Main near Oak Street before proceeding to transfer."}, "S12.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never asked caller to look up the address himself."}, "S12.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 7, "why": "Only one distinguishing question was asked before caller answered with 'near Oak'."}, "S12.judged.6": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never mentioned stock or pickup readiness at the store."}}
